name: Suloctidil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1985 — for liver harm

summary: Suloctidil was removed from the market across the world, starting in 1985, because it caused damage to the liver [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests done on actual people, gave the drug a low liver risk score of 18 [M]. This same computer model also gave the drug a low heart risk score of 46 without testing on humans [M].
